list: The official 55 trophies, as listed 18 November 2026 (Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade)
note: Guides written for this entry in our own words from launch-era research dated 18-21 November 2026. Where sources disagreed or no method was verified, the guide says so instead of guessing. Trophy names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
This is the platinum: it pops the moment you have earned the other 54 trophies, and nothing else is needed for it. There is no multiplayer trophy and no downloadable content to buy, so one single-player playthrough is enough.

Plan on roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace, most of it on the 100% checklist rather than the story. How long it takes is itself disputed: the main guides say about 200 hours, PushSquare warns it can run past 300, and one guide puts it at 100-200. Check the finished list after the 100% checklist, then mop up whatever is left — the platinum lands last.
trophies.dispute: Platinum time is disputed: about 200 hours (PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase) vs 300+ hours (PushSquare) vs 100-200 hours (GameTrek) vs 200-250+ hours (Sixshore).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
Play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is Jason's opening mission, and the trophy unlocks automatically when you finish it.

Nothing here can be missed and nothing special is required — just play the story from the start.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 1 of the story. The trophy actually pops when the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, begins, so keep playing a little past the chapter's end and it will land.

Like every story trophy it is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The trophy pops when the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, starts. The asterisks in the name are how the game itself spells it.

Automatic and unmissable, like the other chapter trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 3 of the story. The trophy pops a little after the chapter ends, once you have played the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

Automatic and unmissable — keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide:
Finish Chapter 4 of the story. The trophy pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, is done.

Automatic and unmissable, like the rest of the chapter trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide:
Finish the final story mission. This is the gold trophy for beating the campaign, and free roam continues afterwards, so nothing is cut off — the real cleanup work, the 100% checklist, only starts here.

Some guides word this trophy as completing Chapter 5 instead of the final mission; the official description says the final mission, and that is what this guide follows.
trophies.dispute: Wording disputed: 'complete the final mission' (kit list, GTABase, 50 Gamerscore on Xbox) vs 'complete Chapter 5' (Beebom, CULTR, OfZen — OfZen lists 100 Gamerscore). This guide follows the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. The trophy pops when the mission ends.

A useful side note: partner switching opens right after this mission, which matters for the two partner trophies later (Hot Together and Retail Therapy).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist, the first of the game's two big story heists (the other is the VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4).

Before the heist itself there is a prep chain — scoping out the Sinfrontera National Bank, a security expert, heist planning, company property, the safe word, the missing link and hidden charges — so follow the mission markers through the setup and the trophy comes with the job.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. The trophy pops when the mission ends.

Automatic and unmissable — just play the Chapter 4 story through.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. The trophy pops when the mission ends.

Automatic and unmissable, like the other mission trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown, the second big story heist after The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

Automatic and unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide:
Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when the mission ends.

Automatic and unmissable — the last of the story-mission trophies before the final mission itself.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, found at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. The checklist only unlocks after the story, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, so start the habits early: scan vehicles, study animals, do optional missions as they appear.

The checklist is long but lenient — it is roughly 60% true game completion. Its lines include about 100 optional missions, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone time trials and all 15 of Bret's target decks. This is the hardest trophy and usually the last one earned. Note the guides disagree on how the checklist is weighted (one presentation says story 50% and tasks 27%; another groups it 45/45/10) — the lines themselves agree, only the grouping differs.
trophies.dispute: Checklist weights are presented two ways by the same outlet: story 50%, tasks 27%, exploration 20% (GTABase interactive checklist) vs Story+Tasks 45%, Exploration+Activities 45%, Discovery 10% (GTABase grouping). The requirement lines agree; only the grouping differs.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida, mixing the four kinds however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Each stunt counts once, so repeats add nothing.

Under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm — there are 202 of them, many close together along the canals. Knife flights happen between tall buildings in Vice City, mostly Downtown and Tequesta, and base jumps are from the tallest peaks and buildings, parachuting to a target. Find stunt jumps under Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and track progress at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. The 100% checklist needs 300 of the 397, so keep going past 250 if you want the gold A Long Road too. Location lists were still incomplete at launch (only 24 of 130 jump spots had been published by 18 November), so expect to hunt for the last few.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide:
Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race or drone race), and a stunt. Doing any one of each is enough — you do not need to win or finish them.

This pops naturally while you chase the other trophies, since fishing, hunting, shooting ranges, racing and stunts all have trophies of their own. If it has not popped by the end, check which of the nine you have never touched and do that one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide:
Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges across the 12 range locations. There are two named ranges: Griffin, in Balsero, with moving courses, and Rodgers Ranch, in Port Gellhorn, with stationary score challenges. Griffin has 6 challenges worth 18 golds and Rodgers has 6 worth 24.

Buy the $5 Waiver Pass from the clerk at each range and the challenges get marked on your map. If you do not own the right weapon type, rent one for $10 — rented guns are good enough for gold. At Griffin, play as Lucia if you can (the guides say she is faster with better handling) and favour speed over bullseyes, since bullseyes only cut a second. At Rodgers, land body shots first to build your multiplier, then go for the headshot, and never miss — misses lower the multiplier. Do the ranges before Gunslinger: every finished challenge raises your Focus stat permanently, which makes that trophy easier. All 42 golds are also needed for 100%.
trophies.dispute: Difficulty tiers are described two ways: PushSquare says most challenges have 3 tiers, while PowerPyx and GTADB say Griffin has 3 gold difficulties per course but Rodgers has 4. This guide follows the per-range split.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide:
Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total — three time trials per location — but the trophy only needs one win at each place, so it comes well before the 100% line, which needs all 42.

Each location's first two time trials must be beaten on par to unlock the third, and the third only needs a finish, any time, for 100%. Locations show as a blue icon when you are within about 100 metres, and you can filter the map at Map, then Activities, then Top Fun Drones, or track progress at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones. Some races charge an entry fee. Taxi fast-travel reaches every location except Dalton Island, which needs a boat or aircraft. Published par times come from a single source, so treat them as a guide, not gospel.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations to choose from, but winning the same race twice does not count — it has to be 20 distinct ones.

Most locations let you hire a car, and the car's rating matters, so pick a strong hire. Races show as blue icons once you are within about 100 metres. The 100% checklist needs 30 of the 40 won, plus 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals as a separate line, so keep racing past 20 if you are going for the gold.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide:
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. First meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; after that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Play through his fishing quests and then take the challenge itself.

The catch you need is a Parrotfish over 2 kg, so bring a boat and a fishing rod. Note that Cal's strand does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy — it is its own thing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide:
Finish any one of the four arcade games. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the home console at Jason's safehouse, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is a light-gun game on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

You only need to finish all the levels of one game once; its side challenges are not needed. It is doable from Chapter 1, though the games are temporarily unavailable during some story sections — they stay available after the story ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Andy's strand and complete its final mission, Puff Puff Pass. This is a Lucia-only strand that opens in Chapter 3: after Lucia finishes Mami Knows Best and Car Service, Andy calls and then texts a new address in Belville.

The strand runs through Climbing the Cellerichain parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and finally Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story ends, and it does not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy — it has a trophy of its own.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide:
Finish Kenton's strand — seven shipwreck treasure-diving sets — and the trophy comes with the final set. Kenton is auto-marked in Chapter 1 with a green KR icon at Key Lento, and the dives start after the story mission Island Dreams, which is his first job.

The strand is temporarily unavailable during part of Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 and 3. You will need a metal detector for the diving. Track progress at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. Only 5 of the 7 sets are needed for 100%, but the trophy needs the final one, so finish the set.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Billy's strand at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The five quests run Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and finally Hometown Heroes.

It is a dirt-bike crew strand with prize money, and at least one mission is solo. It stays available after the story ends, and like the other named-character strands it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide:
Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Four are confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Several others are confirmed not to count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie — because they have trophies of their own, and the same goes for Bret, Randy, Dunk and Shirley. The remaining four counting strands were not confirmed at launch, so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand's final mission; the game does not say which ones count.

Some strands span chapters and take multiple weeks of in-game time — Kirk starts in Chapter 1 but cannot finish until Chapter 2 — so start them early and finish after the story. One report says two of Shirley's missions are Chapter 1 only and Yago's Race Against Yago is Chapter 3 only, so do not leave those strands sitting. All strands stay available after the story. Note this trophy is separate from 100%: most side quests and strangers are not needed for 100% at all.
trophies.dispute: Only 4 of the 8 counting strands are confirmed (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete); the other 4 were unconfirmed at launch. Separately, one report says Shirley's two missions are Chapter 1 only and Yago's Race Against Yago is Chapter 3 only — if true, those are windows, not free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide:
Finish Randy's strand, Randy's Wish List, and the trophy comes with the final delivery. It unlocks halfway through Chapter 3 in the mission Clonin' Keys Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner and introduces Randy as a fence; look for the green RK icon in west Vice City.

The list is 16 sports cars to steal and deliver (one guide counts 18 on the list, another counts 22 — see the dispute below). Delivering a car in good condition pays more, with clean supercars fetching $30,000 or more. The strand stays available after the story, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.dispute: Wish List size is disputed: 18 cars (PowerPyx) vs 22 (PushSquare), with the Pegassi Infernus named in the disagreement. The trophy itself is the final delivery either way.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide:
Finish Tyrone's strand. It is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here Kitty Kitty: first destroy the Synthetic Labs in Take Out Kitty Litter (the Kitty Litter Labs), then run the follow-up quest Spin On This to shut the labs down for good.

Only two missions, and the strand stays available after the story. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_window: Chapter 1 only — the balcony meditation at Jason's house, the morning after Down to Earth.
trophies.guide:
Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Eight of the free-roam spots accept one session each from Jason and Lucia, which makes 16, plus the Chapter 1 balcony session and the final summit session makes 18. Only 15 of the 18 are needed for 100%, so the trophy is stricter than the checklist.

The one window that closes is the first meditation, in Chapter 1 only: finish Down to Earth, and the next morning talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in Key Lento, Mariana County. She says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony; an optional quest popup appears (pink door icon) — look at Lucia (L2/LT) and select Accept (X/A). Save by hand before that morning scene, because there is no mission replay. The last meditation, Ascent on the summit of Mount Kalaga, only appears on the map once every earlier spot is done, and it needs both characters, so it cannot happen until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Other spots include Smooth Sand (a sandbar off the west coast of Capri), the Swamp in Buckskin Swamp, Camp Moonflower on the Emerald River banks, Red Rocks in Manifest County, the Water Wheel in Lummox County and Jutting Cliff in Mount Kalaga National Park. Meditating also raises your Focus stat.
trophies.dispute: Two disputes hang over this trophy. First, whether anything can be missed at all: PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer call this the only possibly missable trophy, while PlanetGTA6 says no reliable missable list exists yet and Vi.ki says no named-source guide had named one as of 19 November. Second, whether the Chapter 1 session even counts: it raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and one guide's author sat at 17/18 before the final and 18/18 after it, so the final may count double. Do the Chapter 1 session anyway — every guide agrees on that.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide:
Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. It is a Jason-only strand that opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you. The first quest is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County, and the strand then runs through Bret's Hunting Decks.

Bring a hunting rifle — the Killtelligence SM-69 is the one the guides name. All 15 of Bret's Target Decks are needed for 100%, so finish the whole deck set, not just the trophy animal. The strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide:
Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 480 cards in 18 sets — sports teams from Vice City, Liberty City and Los Santos, wrestling, comic heroes and club dancers — with set sizes from 12 to 36 cards. Only 3 sets are needed for the trophy, but 100% needs 15 of the 18, so pick the small sets first: Backyard Wrestling is 12 cards, Delights Dancers is 18, and the Vice City Flamingos, Narcos and Manatees sets are 24 each.

Cards can be sold at pawn shops for $20 to over $1,000, but hold them until a set is finished — progress is kept either way. Track your sets at Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Only 63 card locations were known by name at launch, so expect a long hunt for the rest. One count is disputed: the Vice City Manatees set is listed as 24 in the overview but 30 positions appear in the individual list.
trophies.dispute: Vice City Manatees set size is disputed: 24 in the overview vs 30 positions in the individual list (6 unnamed). Total cards 480 and sets 18 are agreed.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide:
Use the WAiNK phone app to scan any 100 locations. Hold Up and R1 to scan when the game alerts you that a scannable is close on foot. The groups are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher Tags — any mix of 100 counts, and there are more than 100 in the world, so you can skip the awkward ones.

Named landmarks to look for include the Lawton Co. Paper Mill, Farmer Scrumpy's Apple Orchard, Gellhorn Fun Fair, Belpoint Lighthouse, the Kalaga Lookout, the Dock Ring and Grayson Assembly. Track progress at Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations. The same app also scans vehicles for Whip It Good. The total number of WAiNK locations is disputed — 108 in one count, 112 in another, differing on how many No Flusher Tags exist — but the trophy only needs 100, so the dispute does not block you.
trophies.dispute: WAiNK total is disputed: 108 (TheGamesWiki: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, 4 Peewees Billboards, 15 No Flusher Tags) vs 112 (GameTrek, GTAScoop: No Flusher Tags 23). Any 100 count for the trophy either way.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide:
Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80, so the trophy is the easier half of the same grind — pick the easiest ones and skip the hardest.

Challenges span Combat, Criminal, Fitness and Survival, and they pay out unlocks as you climb: 10 Combat challenges unlocks a Bravado Banshee, 5 unlocks a Speeder 700 GT, 5 Criminal unlocks a Maibatsu Sanchez and 10 a Western Zombie Bobber. Easy ones to start with are Mugging (rob 5 pedestrians), Stick Ups (rob 3 stores in a day without dying or being arrested), Mugging Spree (steal $500 from pedestrians in a day), Gym Member, Foot Travel (5 miles on foot in a day), Pro Cyclist (15 miles) and Pro Swimmer (3 miles). Track them at Progress, then Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide:
Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area, but the red zone itself. The earliest you can try is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: call your partner in (hold Right and Triangle).

The easiest escape the guides agree on is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy pops once you leave the red zone. It also tends to unlock by itself: robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escaping a vault job with your partner earns this at the same time, and the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is can do it too.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide:
Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. It is available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, once you can call your partner in.

Three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, after you have done the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The chain breaks if your stars fade and only the red heat zone is left, so keep the police chasing. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth shop. This and Hot Together are the only two trophies that specify doing it with your partner.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide:
Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK phone app. You do not need to drive them — scanning is enough — and there are 557 vehicles in the game at launch, including boats and aircraft, so scan from the start of the story and you will reach 100 naturally.

Track progress at Progress, then Vehicles. Note that discovering, purchasing and registering are three separate progress verbs in this game: this trophy is discovering, Little Boxes is purchasing garages and On the Spot is registering. The 100% line is disputed in wording — the checklist reads 200 of 277 base model vehicles, while the guide text says scan any 200 of 557 — and standout unique cars at fixed spots do not count toward it.
trophies.dispute: 100% vehicle line is worded two ways in the same guide: '200 of 277 base model vehicles' (checklist wording) vs 'scan any 200 of 557 vehicles' (guide text). The trophy itself needs only 100 discovered, so either reading is fine for it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide:
Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm — it slows time while you aim. Before you try, build your Focus: eat and drink, take a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline, which extends Focus. An assault rifle is recommended, and the Duke 556 is the one the guides name.

Pick your targets carefully: the guides say it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use gang members — the guards at an illegal operation are a good crowd. Focus has 4 levels and rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so do the shooting ranges first (The Shootist) and this gets much easier. Busy story firefights are another good place to try it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide:
Steal a large passenger plane at Vice City International Airport and fly it away. It has to be a plane docked at a departure terminal and connected to a boarding bridge — E3 and E4 are the ones the guides name — not an aircraft parked elsewhere on the field.

Get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane out toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops, delayed. Driving through the airfield fence is quicker than going through the terminal. Only 0.47% of tracked players had earned it at launch, one of the rarest trophies in the set.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide:
Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the south-west edge of Mariana County. Several tanks sit unlocked south of the air base; drive in through the gate or over a stunt jump, climb in and shoot the enemies from inside it.

Driving one off the base brings a 3-star wanted level, so expect a chase. Only 0.93% of tracked players had earned it at launch.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide:
Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun, a silent lockpick. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door, find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe quietly and leave without touching the front cases — kicking the door in triggers the alarm.

Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the spot the guides name. This is a quiet robbery, separate from the 35 smash 'n' grabs in the world, of which 34 count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide:
Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail a security van: follow the armored van until it stops, then enter the bank while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash bags alone.

Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, and one bank can pay up to about $205,000. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and 100% needs all 8, so the trophy is five of the same grind. Yasmani also tips you $10,000 after two Payday Loan robberies, which is a good way to warm up.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide:
Rob an armored truck and escape. The easy way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, where a vault job counts for this trophy automatically. For the open-world method, find an armored truck near a bank and stick a sticky bomb on its back door — sticky bombs are sold at Ammu-Nation and at the back of Yasmani's shop in Little Cuba once his jobs are done — then grab the cash and get away.

Escaping means clearing the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. One single-source report warns this trophy can fail on direct truck robberies, so if a truck robbery does not pop it, use the Chapter 4 mission route instead. The name is a nod to the Blitz Play heist from GTA V.
trophies.dispute: DamnModz (single source, unconfirmed) reports this trophy can fail on direct truck robberies. If a truck robbery does not pop it, use the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is instead.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide:
Explore all of Leonida. The map starts fogged, and the trophy counts once no fog is left — the count behind it is the 52 areas in the official list. A plane is the fastest way to clear it, and one is gettable early in Chapter 1.

The check is lenient: players have earned it with a few small dark patches still left, so do not obsess over every corner. Cover the six destinations the Rockstar site names — Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga — and sweep the rest by air.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide:
Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and 100% needs all 39, but the trophy only needs one per gang.

Operations do not show on the map until you physically enter the location; then a yellow icon appears and stays marked. Use the map filter at Map, then Robberies, then Illegal Operations, and check per-gang counts at Progress, then Gangs. The nine groups are the Kingfishers (3 operations), Kolts & Associates (5, including Kingpin Bowling), M7 (2), La Polilla Negra (2), Final Chapter (4), San4San (5), PTT Youngin$ (2), Guardia Brothers (3) and Other Criminals (13). An operation only counts as robbed when you collect every key valuable inside, so hover the icon first to see its security level and listed valuables. The narcotics you steal go to fences — Brian and Donnie in south Key Lento from Chapter 1, and Dunk in Port Gellhorn from Chapter 2 — and 100% needs $100,000 of narcotics fenced.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide:
Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. That is the whole of what the launch-era guides can confirm: every guide that lists this trophy says the exact trigger is still unknown, and none of them names a bar or a location.

Do not chase a rumoured spot for this one — no verified method exists yet. Check back against a current guide once players have pinned the trigger down, and treat any method you see online as unconfirmed until two independent guides agree on it.
trophies.unconfirmed: No method was verified anywhere in the launch-era sources (PowerPyx, GameMapa, KeenGamer, EGamers, LeonidaInteractive all say the exact trigger is unknown). This guide does not invent a bar or location.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide:
Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic style. No launch-era guide has a verified method for this one — PowerPyx and KeenGamer both say it is still unknown.

The best guess in circulation, from GTABase and GTASix.how, is to crash a car out through a showroom window. That is a guess, not a confirmed method, so try it and see, and do not be surprised if it takes a different approach once players work it out.
trophies.unconfirmed: No confirmed method in any launch-era source. GTABase and GTASix.how guess it involves crashing a car out through a showroom window — recorded here as a guess only, not a verified step.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide:
Rob the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, the Kolt & Associates gang operation. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe contents in the north-east hallway office (sticky bombs open the safe). Then escape the police — the trophy pops after you lose them, not when you pick up the third item.

You first visit the alley in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. It is not missable: the robbery respawns, and the operation is one of the five Kolts & Associates sites that count toward Pest Control.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide:
Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, once you can switch characters. Get a gym membership and work out together — while one trains, the partner trains too, so both gain progress at once.

Strength and Cardio each have 4 levels, raised one level at a time; a full workout meter is one level. You can also work out at home after the story (bench press, deadlift, kettlebell). Check each character's Strength in the Jason & Lucia menu. Only 0.19% of tracked players had earned it at launch. A related challenge, Strength Regime, asks you to hold Strength level 4 on both characters for 5 consecutive days.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide:
Do 500 things that change your Criminal Profile. The counter sits on the trophy itself, and most players earn this naturally: every robbery and enemy encounter adds to it, through stealth robberies, wounding instead of killing, and violence. Turn on the Criminal Profile notification in settings to see which actions count.

Watch the profile itself, though. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable, and Irredeemable is permanent — police become permanently more aggressive in free roam, which makes collectible hunting harder. If you are short at the end, the quickest farm the guides report is running people down with a car, but keep an eye on the profile meter while you do it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide:
The description hints at a second attempt, but the big guides — PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GameMapa and EGamers — all list this trophy's method as unconfirmed. The one specific method in circulation comes from a single source, DamnModz: after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, return alone as Lucia to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba from the prologue, empty all three cash drawers, then leave the police search area on foot — getting away in a vehicle does not earn it.

A third claim conflicts with both: OfZen calls it a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. This guide treats that claim as unverified and shows the DamnModz method as reported, not confirmed — try it, but do not count on it until a second guide confirms it.
trophies.dispute: Three-way disagreement: unconfirmed (PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GameMapa, EGamers) vs a specific method from one source (DamnModz: Lucia alone, Payday Loans in Little Cuba after Credit Check, empty 3 drawers, leave the search area on foot) vs OfZen's claim that it is a story trophy unlocking during the campaign. The DamnModz method is reported, not confirmed.
trophies.unconfirmed: No method is confirmed by two independent sources. The DamnModz method above is the only specific one reported, from a single source.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide:
Something strange happens somewhere in Leonida — but the big guides (PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GameMapa) all list the trigger as unconfirmed. The reported method, from BoostingFactory and DamnModz, is a UFO event: go alone, without your partner, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel outside Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, after 2 AM. Look for a flashing car; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the light into the woods toward the UFO's blue glow, help the stranded woman, walk her back to her car — then the UFO returns and abducts your character, and the trophy triggers. Either Jason or Lucia can do it, and it is not part of the 100% checklist.

Two details are still disputed: the time window is given as after 2 AM by the guides and as 2 to 6 AM by a Facebook reel summary. OfZen, meanwhile, claims it is a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign, which conflicts with the UFO-event reports. Treat the UFO method as reported, not confirmed, until the big guides verify it.
trophies.dispute: Unconfirmed by the big guides vs a UFO method reported by BoostingFactory and DamnModz (Kelly County, Starlet Motel, after 2 AM, alone, flashing car, help the woman, abduction) vs OfZen's claim of a story trophy. The time window is also disputed: 'after 2 AM' vs '2-6 AM' (Facebook reel).
trophies.unconfirmed: The UFO method is reported by two secondary sources and unconfirmed by PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GameMapa. Not part of the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide:
Knock targets down with a melee drive-by — but exactly how is disputed three ways. The most specific report, from DamnModz alone, says kick 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds while riding a motorbike or bicycle (press Square to kick), with Ocean Beach and the busy Vice City streets as good hunting grounds. GamerBlurb instead describes knocking targets down during a melee drive-by, with no count or timer, and TechNerdiness advises grabbing it during busy story firefights — which conflicts with the kicking method.

PowerPyx lists the method as unconfirmed, and so do BoostingFactory, TheGamersHub and GameMapa. This guide shows all three candidate methods and flags the trophy unconfirmed rather than picking one silently; try the bike-kick method first, since it is the only one with a concrete count and timer. Only 0.19% of tracked players had earned it at launch.
trophies.dispute: Three candidate methods conflict: kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds on a bike (DamnModz, single source) vs melee drive-by knockdowns (GamerBlurb) vs busy story firefights (TechNerdiness). PowerPyx, BoostingFactory, TheGamersHub and GameMapa all list it unconfirmed.
trophies.unconfirmed: No method is confirmed. The bike-kick method is the only one with a concrete count and timer, but it comes from a single source.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide:
Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. The total is cumulative, not all at once. It unlocks in Chapter 3 with the Credit Check mission, which also gives you the Dye Pack Jammer you need to sell marked bills to a fence.

Bank and Payday Loan money comes as marked bills that you cannot spend right away — hand them to a fence, who launders them for a cut. Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for marked bills, and you can deliver cash to him or to a garage for pickup. Bank vaults pay up to about $205,000 each, so vault jobs fill the total fast. The same $250,000 line appears on the 100% checklist. Never use the $250,000 cheat for this: cheats turn off trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide:
Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative and any shop types count — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest ways to burn money. The guides do not say whether the spending must be spread across different vendors, so do not worry about that.

Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores and 11 tattoo studios, and you can find shops on the map through the Touch Pad, then Style. Leave this until you have money piling up from normal play; it usually finishes itself. Spending is not itself a 100% checklist line, though it overlaps the fencing and shopping economy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide:
Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, for $160,000 in total. They are sold through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Four extra story garages exist but are not needed for this trophy.

Garages also add storage: registered cars start with 3 slots, and buying garages adds more. Paradise Garage in Watson Bay is one named garage. Remember the three vehicle verbs are different: discovering is Whip It Good, purchasing is this trophy, registering is On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide:
Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens in Chapter 2 after the Moses mission Take A Vehicle to Moses. Register at Moses in Port Gellhorn (Respray plus Register); from Chapter 3 onward, Pay 'n' Spray locations with standard trackers can do it too, for about $4,000 a car.

Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down, and make sure you have garage spots for them — you need somewhere to keep each registered vehicle. The Scooter Bros app also delivers your own car to you for a fee once it is registered.
